groups.name: dynamics
groups.basis: Leland Text/music dynamics height ratios are about 1.9. Apply one scale to letters and complete ligatures to retain their relative proportions.

groups.name: octave-text
groups.basis: Measured fixed-host native baseline height is 0.954sp; unadapted Study is 0.853sp for 8va and 0.875sp for 8. A shared 1.1 factor keeps their proportions near the actual baseline. The theoretical 2.0 EM conversion was rejected after native comparison because it made both marks too large.

groups.name: pedal-word
groups.basis: Measured native baseline word height is 1.744sp, versus 1.109sp before adaptation. A 1.6 factor restores comparable size while retaining the source word proportions; the generic Leland Text/music 1.3 ratio alone under-corrected this source outline.

groups.name: pedal-release
groups.basis: Measured native release-star height is 1.144sp in the baseline versus 0.991sp before adaptation. A 1.15 factor restores comparable size.

notes: Text-only calibration. Never apply these factors to the music font or to the original captured reference geometry.
Metronome glyphs remain unchanged: the real Leland Text route uses Metronome Text 3, whose quarter-note ink height is about 1073 units rather than the smaller modern Leland Text subset.
User score style sizes and per-element overrides remain authoritative; no score XML size or offset changes.
